blocks.goal: Extract the configuration and mutation responsibilities (allowed tags, attributes, enforced attributes, protocols, and relative-link policy) from Safelist into a new cohesive SafelistConfig class to reduce the number of public mutation methods on Safelist and improve modularization.

expected_impact.rationale: Move the public mutation/configuration methods and their backing fields into SafelistConfig. This directly reduces Safelist's public method count by removing ten public mutator/accessor methods (addTags, removeTags, addAttributes, removeAttributes, addEnforcedAttribute, removeEnforcedAttribute, addProtocols, removeProtocols, preserveRelativeLinks(boolean), preserveRelativeLinks()) and moves several large maps/sets out of Safelist, reducing its LOC and concentrating configuration responsibility into a single new class.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.safety.SafelistConfig in the same package. SafelistConfig will own the configuration fields and provide the public mutation API: addTags, removeTags, addAttributes, removeAttributes, addEnforcedAttribute, removeEnforcedAttribute, addProtocols, removeProtocols, preserveRelativeLinks(boolean), and preserveRelativeLinks() getter. SafelistConfig will use the existing nested typed classes from Safelist (Safelist.TagName, Safelist.AttributeKey, Safelist.AttributeValue, Safelist.Protocol, Safelist.TypedValue) by referencing them (they remain nested in Safelist). The new class will encapsulate: Set<TagName> tagNames; Map<TagName, Set<AttributeKey>> attributes; Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, AttributeValue>> enforcedAttributes; Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, Set<Protocol>>> protocols; boolean preserveRelativeLinks. Each moved method will be implemented in SafelistConfig with the same behavior as in Safelist. The class will expose package-private getters for the internal collections to allow Safelist to query them (e.g., getTagNames(), getAttributes(), getEnforcedAttributesMap(), getProtocols(), isPreserveRelativeLinks()).

Move the following fields from Safelist into SafelistConfig: tagNames, attributes, enforcedAttributes, protocols, and preserveRelativeLinks. The moved fields keep their existing types (using Safelist.TagName, Safelist.AttributeKey, Safelist.AttributeValue, Safelist.Protocol). Safelist will replace direct field access with a private final SafelistConfig config field and will use config's package-private accessors to query data.

Move the listed public mutation and configuration methods from Safelist into the new SafelistConfig class. Implementations are preserved. The methods will operate on the moved fields inside SafelistConfig. After move, these methods are removed from Safelist. Safelist will hold a private final SafelistConfig config; existing Safelist logic that needs to mutate or query configuration will call config's methods or access its package-private getters. Static factory methods (none, simpleText, basic, basicWithImages, relaxed) will be adjusted in Safelist to call config methods on the new SafelistConfig instance when building presets (these factory methods remain in Safelist).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
